notes.title: Path of Kami Patch 3.0.7
notes.content:
Hello Wolf Pack! Thank you all for playing our game, we are super excited to share that the game now has a positive rating on steam, thank you all for sharing your thoughts with us and for leaving reviews! It means the world to us ːsteamhappyː We are thrilled to share that we have added some updates requested from the community along with additional optimization, QoL and bug fixes. 

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Game updates[/h2]
- Added SFX for spirit portal
- Adjusted the volume levels of the music for level 2 and ending song
- Added vocals for Oboroguruma
- Other additional SFX and QoL enhancements
- Optimization improvements for art and lighting
- Updated Control settings to now have input binding
- Added additional invert camera options
- Additional tidbits of lore have been added throughout the game. This lore is optional and can access it by 'inspecting.' 
- Updated IK to not be active when falling or jumping, this should help with the 'floaty' feeling when jumping around and also not flying off the platforms while jumping off

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed: If fire from a lantern was taken back before getting collectible, can't pick it up
- Some missing localization for all languages
- Fixed: Pressing ESC in the collectible menu makes the cursor disappear
- Fixed: When using Xbox controller it automatically lists PS controller as Xbox
- Fixed Some audio tracks that weren't playing
- Game no longer crashes when starting a new game in full-screen mode
- Updated steam achievement typo
- Updated Cave of Reflection introductory area to close gap in debri (this was causing some players to get stuck)
- Fixed spirit fountain SFX. Now the water sound should only play if the fountain has water in it.
- Fixed collectible SFX bug. Now they will play an ambient sound until collected. Then after collecting, if you reload a save, the collectibles won't play a sound if they've been collected. Also, collectibles that haven't been activated won't play ambient sound until they are activated.
- Paw prints are now green when using Earth Element

notes.title: Path of Kami Journey Begins Patch Update 3.0.5
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Thank you all for the wonderful feedback and for playing the game. It means so much to us to have all of you with us, thank you to everyone sharing your thoughts and bug reports with us. Excited to share we'll be fixing some of the bugs reported, apologies on the wait were a small team and it takes a bit of time for us to get to things but we hope you enjoy it! So...lets get to it ːwinter2019cooldogː

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Game Updates
[/h2]- Update to suspension bridge, if its not on the same side, there's now a prompt to call it over
- Optimization improvements for art and lighting
- Removed floating fish in crescent cove
- Worldbuilding Updates to Spirit World

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed Menu Bugs
- Fixed getting stuck in photo mode
- Fixed issue with getting stuck under the world when respawning
- Fixed issue with game crashing when changing levels 
- Updated collision on some assets
- Fixed instances where wisp may split into two in small spaces
- Save system refactor and bug fixes

[b]Note[/b]: We tried as best we could to make the save data compatible as much as possible but with the refactoring and improvements it was difficult to get it completely in sync. It's recommended to start a new game with this update as the save data will not be completely compatible. We apologize for the inconvenience, with this update this shouldn't be a problem in the future!

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
- Input Control Binding
- Various bug fixes
- Additional Optimization Improvements

What else would you like to see next? Let us know in the steam discussions ːsteamhappyː

[h2]DevGamm Started today![/h2]
We're super excited to be participating in the #DevGAMM Game Festival on Steam which started today! Catch us in the Steam Game Fest Showcase ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/devgamm2022

[h3]Leave a Review[/h3]

Enjoy the game? Remember to leave a review, it helps small teams like us a ton!

notes.title: Issue with Purchasing Collectors Bundle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/694ecf76c55e54e08c229dc11fdf0abc468ecde8.png[/img]

Hi everyone! 👋 We became aware of an issue with purchasing the bundle on steam. Apologies for the inconvenience, happy to share that the issue has now been resolved! 

[h3]What Happened?[/h3]

There was a bug where the lorebook and artbook were being included with the base game, even if the bundle wasn't purchased. This bug has now been resolved, this means if you haven't purchased the bundle it will no longer show up in your DLC.

Thank you all for your patience while we worked on this!

[h2]About This Bundle[/h2]
The Path of Kami Journey Begins: Collectors Edition is packed with a variety of diverse additions that help flesh out the world of Path of Kami. Featuring the base game, accompanying soundtrack, lore book, and artbook. All of this will give you a look behind the scenes at the development process and what it took to make our relaxing wolf adventure game.

You can find the Collectors Bundle Below:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28772/Path_of_Kami_Journey_Begins_Collectors_Edition/

notes.title: Path of Kami Demo Update v3.03
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/16fa04e58596d605f6b72822885be66a2c2a9894.png[/img]

Hi everyone! In celebration of the Steam Next Festival next week we have pushed an update to the demo. We hope you enjoy it! Let us know what you think ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Game Updates
[/h2]
- Kazeyo got a new look!

- Updated fonts

- Added localization as a setting in general settings

- Added separate invert controls for camera and controls

- Worldbuilding in all areas

- New activities: Find the bells and ring them & Light Lanterns on the water

- Lanterns now have two different models to help convey what it does! Lanterns are categorized as Spirit or Elemental. Spirit Lanterns can be used to activate spirit pools by revealing Wandering Spirits you have to catch. Spirit lanterns focus on exploration rather than puzzle solving, also reveals collectibles. Elemental Lanterns are used primarily for traversal puzzles. This is the lantern in the shape of a circle.

- New tutorial dialogue and dialogue to explain objectives

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

- Translation bugs

- Made menus dynamic to adjust for localization

- Animation bug which caused drifting

- Missing colliders on some models

notes.title: Path of Kami September Dev Log + Upcoming Events
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It’s almost spooky season, time has sure flown by. This week we don’t have much visual progress to share but can say that we are working away at the game and prepping for event season that’s starting soon! We’ll share one of the first events we’ll go to in a bit.

But first...here are some game development updates!

[h1]Dev Updates[/h1]
[h2]Implementation, Bug fixing, and Polish Pass[/h2]
Not much to show here visually but we’ve been working on some bug fixing and polish for our UI and worldbuilding. We’ve completely implemented our collection and UI welcome system :)

We also updated our credits menu to be in a grid layout to be more organized, still needs some cleanup but its looking better already! Also added a little bit more explanation text for the spirit pool system.

[h2]Advanced Settings[/h2]
Added toggle to be able to turn post-processing off or on! (This is the painterly effect we have in-game that is noticeable in the distance)

[h2]Concept Art[/h2]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39910938/a48ee9f62193ddacfb5ff4df7bc147006e6f7634.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39910938/c93bfcb5c5410a91ef9497c96cde5338e5acd09d.jpg[/img]

We’ve also been doing some concept art for some of the platforms we have in-game for navigational puzzles.

[h2]Localization is in![/h2]
We’re excited to share that we have implemented our localization system and we now have: English, Spanish (Latin), Spanish (Spain), Simplified Chinese, and Japanese!

More languages coming soon! We plan on adding more in future updates as well.

These languages will be included in the next demo update.

[h1]Events[/h1]
[h2]MEGAMIGS[/h2]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39910938/b6b15965ebe0f6fef78d56f3e9a4067f2728a94d.png[/img]

[url=https://megamigs.com/en/]MEGAMIGS[/url] is an event dedicated to the video game industry and is one of the largest events in Canada, MEGAMIGS brings together hundreds of video game creators and players from around the world each year! Visit us at our virtual booth.

We put together some special trailers for the event, you can check out the teaser on [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCGrEokk0D1hEUrIumYS1j0Q]our youtube channel.[/url]

https://youtu.be/PIxxfFIbCvE

Details to be released soon!

[h2]Wallpaper Giveaway[/h2]
We will be doing a wallpaper giveaway soon for newsletter subscribers, if you're not already[url=https://captilight.us5.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=b88b4d4ea574262ec6a1c33a8&id=fa7df54ff6] join today![/url]

[h2]Merch Giveaway [/h2]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39910938/5a557092e2652dedf92790ae622710c0746f465b.png[/img]

Mark your calendar’s we’ll be doing a merch giveaway next month starting Oct. 14th! There are three prizes that can be won, each is a package full of goodies! 

[url=https://giv.gg/C0iEOF]You can get an early look here.[/url]
Thanks for tuning in,

Captilight team

notes.title: Path of Kami Prologue August Dev Log
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39910938/d225592a9106e250baa41f849f8f300671eb36d7.png[/img]

Hello Wolf Pack!

We hope you’ve been well, it feels like it’s been forever since our last dev log but its only been a month! We got SO much to talk about in this update so let’s get to it!

[h1]Dev Updates[/h1]

[h2]Worldbuilding[/h2]

We’ve been marching on creating additional props and building up the mortal world of Path of Kami! Below are some cool stuff we’ve been working on.

[h3]Jizo Statues[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/f713606e31b63c36a4224584b0dd3d81ca440d0c.png[/img]

Jizo (地蔵/womb of the earth) is made in the image of Jizo Bosatsu, guardian deity of children and travelers. They are regarded as ancient protectors, we thought it’d fit well with Kazeyo on his journey to the spirit world! Here are a few variations the team has put together!

[h3]Moonlight Falls Area[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/8e362338237bf9a415b28de2a7a70601492d59f4.png[/img]

We have completely revamped the shrine area that leads to moonlight falls. We don’t want to give away TOO much of the future demo update coming soon but here’s a little sneak peek :)

[h2]UI Updates![/h2]
We added welcome area prompts to welcome you to new areas you’ll encounter! Comes with a fancy animation too <3 For the prologue release we’ll tie these and future areas to achievements :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/f0e0c97249c905de314ed94fbb07d8dced00a75a.png[/img]

A collectible inventory menu has been implemented!! Each time you enter a new area you’ll get a number of collectibles in the area. As you find them you’ll unlock them in the menu.

For the prologue, we plan on adding additional information about items and lore here as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/ab61be688a2d5a9c89213fca548d8167818f73e8.png[/img]

We also added new art for the pause menu to make it consistent with all other menus in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/7f3cec9afa389bd0d55f450abd2980a10cdb3d35.png[/img]

[h2]Photo Mode Implementation[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/d71c0316c8475b803a3d5dad4e1bb6b92de65fcc.png[/img]
We’ve implemented a photo mode so you can take all sorts of photo masterpieces in the game!! Here is some work in progress shots of some of the UI updates we were doing for it.

[h1]Demo News + Upcoming Updates[/h1]
We plan on releasing a big demo update in the next couple of weeks to officially close out the demo. In the update it’ll include the above changes along with:
[list]
[*] Advanced Settings such as turning off post-processing etc.
[*] Menu’s interactable with a controller
[*] Additional dialogue
[*] Updated credits menu
[*] We also plan on doing Mac and Linux builds!
[/list]

[h1]Merch Store Updates![/h1]
[h2]New Items[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/0cfdeddf9618b12a24fe38dc72809dfa10e86451.png[/img]
We’ve added the omikuji fortunes to the [url=https://www.etsy.com/listing/1063354018/path-of-kami-omikuji-fortune-bookmarks]Etsy Shop [/url]purchasable as bookmarks! 

We hope you enjoyed today’s update!

Have a wonderful weekend,

Deana @Captilight

notes.title: Path of Kami Demo Launch + Update for Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/f067c2573175ade0f9d72f1351272c3f71271a6b.png[/img]

Hello Den Dwellers! Today we launched our demo for Steam #NEXTFEST. We previously had an early demo on[url=https://captilightgames.itch.io/path-of-kami-demo] itch io [/url] and [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/pathofkamidemo/585581]gamejolt[/url], in case you checked that out this update comes with some major environmental changes and new content for the event! We can't wait to hear what you think, we hope you enjoy the new build and event! 

If you haven't heard we recently released the soundtrack for the game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1647880/Path_of_Kami_Soundtrack/]steam [/url]and [url=https://music.choiby.com/album/path-of-kami-prologue-ost]Bandcamp[/url]. Check it out if you enjoy relaxing tunes.

[h2] Update Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Bug Fixes/Performance enhancements[/h3]
- Fixed Collider issues on various props

- Missing Collectible Cutscene for Dotaku Bell

- Redid spirit collectible to be better on performance

- Added additional LODs

- Mouse sensitivity in menus

- Flying on Wisp bug

- Scaling issues for menus and splash screen on small resolutions

- Wisp bumping into player

- Screen going black when getting close to waterfall in Moonlight Falls Area

[h3]Updates[/h3]
- Added props and buildings to Moonlight Falls (waterfall area)

- Worldbuilding throughout the level!

- Skybox color rotations

- Pause menu art

- "New Game" option 

- Implemented final art for Spirit Key / Pressure Plate system!

- Additional sound effects and improvements to dynamic music 

- Kazeyo can now hold objects in his mouth and no longer has to be 'one with the cube'

- Inverted controls!

- Updated verbiage for sacred fountain tutorial and introduce 'take back fire' mechanic earlier in-game

- Space button tutorial for dialogue

- Added more dialogue!

[h3]Known Bugs[/h3]
- Rare instances of Wisp glitching

- Save issues with statues/spirit keys

[h3]Plans for upcoming updates:
[/h3]
- Photo mode

- Collectibles inventory

- Hint System

- Mac & Linux builds

notes.title: Crowdfunding Campaign 20% Funding Goal, Dev Updates + Events
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/7ab2d202dca9f11f448bca5c5cabb60623db38cd.png[/img]

Grab a cup of tea or coffee, whichever is your fancy cause this is gonna be a bit of a read! But lots of cool stuff.....It's been a while since we've shared some game updates so here we go! We've been working on worldbuilding and collectibles. We're still finishing some things on the demo but starting to see the light at the end of the tunnel! We're currently working on bug fixing and polish mainly for our menus. We've most recently been working on some UI improvements on our collectible pop-ups.

[h2]Check it out[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/f2869ac3e28562726688b7e82602218adafe96ff.gif[/img]

We've also been working on some new props to fill various areas we have. Here's an early sneak peek on some of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/7149e84c1288192d897b2701bbf6e44dec6a6a53.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/42f82c825294a067cd6805ca0d0524839d0cd631.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/42fc6d9f650d4d4fc331a7472467cf433a91651a.png[/img]

[h2][url=https://ifundwomen.com/projects/captilight-games-move-you]Campaign Updates:[/url] Now 20% Funded![/h2]

We are excited to announce that we have hit a new milestone for [url=https://ifundwomen.com/projects/captilight-games-move-you]our crowdfunding campaign[/url], we are now 20% funded! 🎉 Thank you everyone for your support! 
 
 If you donated to a tier that has the Special Discord Role please message us and we'll assign the role to you <3

[h2]Social Goals Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/cd4034b77af70d8ff2efaf1ba96e7d89c6eaea30.png[/img]

We are currently hosting a Path of Kami Community Pet Challenge we were asking everyone to tag us (@captilight) and use the hashtag #PoKPets! Or feel free to share them in the discord we'll be highlighting pets later in the campaign.

Progress towards social media goals
[url=https://youtu.be/aQ4uishADTM]
Prologue Trailer 1k Views:[/url] 914| 126 until we reach goal!
50 Path of Kami Pets: 7 | 43 until we reach goal!

Take a look at our social goals on the campaign page and see how you can help!

[h2]Giveaway Winners[/h2]

Our Path of Kami Campaign Giveaway ended last week with our winners: HeroSebXD, paraskuron, MemesRedeeming, JonahDearth + AlexWifi42! [url=https://givelab.com/FRcQuC/path-of-kami-launch-giveaway]Check out the deets here.[/url]

[h2]Features[/h2]
Our founder got featured on Womenize! Inspiring Stories talking about how she created Captilight and our work with Path of Kami. [url=https://www.womenize.net/2021/03/17/deana-galbraith-womenize-inspiring-stories/]Check it out here.[/url]
 
SGTVA Game Puppet show featured Path of Kami and Captilight on their latest episode! [url=https://youtu.be/LcqwM3u1m1Y]You can watch the show here.[/url]

[url=https://adventuregamers.com/news/view/path-of-kami-heading-toward-pc-debut-later-this-year]Adventure Gamer [/url]and [url=https://www.offgamers.com/blog/relaxing-puzzle-game-path-of-kami-prologue-coming-to-steam/]Off Gamers[/url] also did a piece on the Path of Kami Prologue about releasing later this year!

[h2]Events[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/9d05d764995bfa30df1211a5b7c939785545b7c5.png[/img]

We're thrilled to announce we'll be participating in [url=https://www.egdcollective.org/wafflegames2021]Waffle Games by EGD Collectiv[/url]e, we'll be having a Virtual Booth where you can stop by get the latest news and talk with the team. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949073/0b03f4259410cf344415f5694810140bb4ad1430.png[/img]

We will also be exhibiting at the Game Carnival this summer! More deets to come soon :)

[h2]Connect With Us[/h2]

Join us on [url=https://linktr.ee/captilight]social media, discord and more! [/url]

Thanks so much for tuning in! Stay safe and healthy!

Captilight Team
